A_primary.question: Third replication: in thin books, does C3_hat predict next-hour MAE beyond volatility, flow, depth, OI AND four price-impact controls?
A_primary.success: Clark-West one-sided p < 0.025 AND 97.5% date-block bootstrap CI of dR2 above 0

B_primary.other_rules: guard_summed: R = U6 * S60 (the theorem's bound with U6 = 95th pct of |normalized flow| in [t-360,t)); guard_peak: R = U6 * max_k |h_k|; static: R = 1
B_primary.question: Does the amplification multiple of Paper 2's guard improve a volatility-scaled position limit, i.e. lower tail loss per unit of average position?
B_primary.rule_reference: vol: R = rv_360 (std of 1-minute log-price changes in [t-360,t))
B_primary.rule_test: amp_vol: R = rv_360 * GM^theta, GM = S60/|h_0| (summed |impulse response| over 60 minutes divided by impact; unit-free), theta chosen from {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1} by minimum TRAINING TLR (theta = 0 is the plain volatility limit, so a useless GM makes the test fail)
B_primary.sizing: q = c_s / R, R winsorized at pooled training 1%/99%, c_s sets the training mean of q to 1 per symbol and rule; hours where any rule's R is missing are dropped for all rules
B_primary.statistic: TLR = ES95(L) / mean(q) on test, pooled over thin symbols
B_primary.success: log TLR_amp_vol - log TLR_vol < 0 with the 97.5% date-block bootstrap CI below 0

C_primary.per_symbol: price-only: 5-min flow on 12 lagged 5-min returns, kernel fitted by two exponentials; tagged: n_c,t = r_c n_c,t-1 + w_c ret_t for 3 classes; 200 day-bootstrap draws
C_primary.question: Paper 1: from prices and flow alone the memory RATES are not identified but the merged response IS; class-tagged positions identify the rates.
C_primary.sample: all 30 symbols, fresh test days with metrics data (>= 15 days)
C_primary.success: at least 80% of evaluable symbols pass
C_primary.symbol_passes_if: (i) mean price-only rate CI width / mean tagged rate CI width > 10, AND (ii) price-only rate CI width > 0.25, AND (iii) 95% CI of the merged response M0 = sum k_m excludes 0

data: Binance USD-M futures; training = cached 10th/24th of each month 2023-2024 (as Parts 4-5); test = FRESH days, the 3rd and 17th of each month, 2025-01-01 to 2026-09-30, never downloaded before; validation V1-V5 unchanged
inference: Clark-West (Newey-West 6 lags); 2,000 date-block bootstrap draws (all symbols on a date together)
multiplicity: Paper 2 has two primary hypotheses (A, B): each is tested at alpha = 0.025 with 97.5% bootstrap CIs (Bonferroni). Paper 1 has one primary (C) at alpha = 0.05. Secondary tests are Holm-adjusted within each paper.
runs: the test cell Z6 is run once; every run is counted in prereg/test_set_unlocks_p6.json
secondary_paper1: thin+mid: MAE | tagged position features n_top_pos, d_top_pos_60, n_all, d_all_60 (value of disclosure)
share of symbols whose top-position vs all-accounts memory-rate CI excludes 0
secondary_paper2: thin: MAE | C3_flow (C3 re-estimated without depth: kappa^2 eta q - (1-a) kappa; validates Part 7)
unit: symbol-hour blocks, hours 6-23 UTC; features from minutes [t-360, t); outcome from (t, t+60]
